title: DevX signals sprintboard alignment for SDKs, docs, and quickstarts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidate initiative-level signals (activation, time-to-first-success, churn after sample app) into a single sprintboard view and cadence to align PM, Eng, and Design for the SDKs/docs/quickstarts pillar. Deliverables: a sprintboard template, mapping of signals to OKRs, a lightweight dashboard slice for the Console team, and a playbook for weekly signal review. This ticket coordinates owners, defines measurement, and schedules rollout across three squads: SDK Platform, Docs, and Sample Apps.
acceptance_criteria: Sprintboard template created in Linear with sections for signals, experiments, blockers, and action owners
Signal mapping doc linking metrics to OKRs and owners stored in Drive and referenced in the sprintboard
Three-week pilot run with SDK Platform and Docs squads showing actionable changes from signals
Dashboard slice in Console that surfaces top 5 DevX signals and ability to filter by project and cycle
tasks: Workshop with PM/Design/Eng to define canonical signals and owners
Draft sprintboard layout and add to Linear blueprint
Implement Drive doc with metric definitions and query SQL for data team
Coordinate with Console team for minimal dashboard slice and filter requirements
Run 3-week pilot and collect before/after signal changes
Incorporate feedback, publish playbook, and schedule handoff to program leads
progress_updates: 2026-02-18: Kickoff workshop completed; agreed on 7 core signals (activation_rate, time_to_first_success, sample_app_completion, sdk_installation_errors, doc_search_failure_rate, quickstart_time_minutes, retention_week1)
2026-02-25: Sprintboard template prototyped; PM/Design feedback requested; moved to In Review
2026-03-03: Data team validated SQL for activation_rate and time_to_first_success; Console scope narrowed to top 5 signals for MVP
2026-03-10: Pilot cohort identified (SDK Platform + Docs); pilot start scheduled for 2026-03-15
risks: Signal definitions may diverge across squads leading to inconsistent measurement
Data latency for some metrics (doc search failures) could delay weekly cadence
Console team bandwidth constraints might push dashboard MVP beyond pilot window
metrics: Target: +12% activation_rate for quickstarts in pilot cohort within 4 weeks
Target: reduce time_to_first_success by 30% for new SDK users
Target: decrease sample_app_completion friction events by 40%
